synopsis_paragraphs: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia (Tenmaku no Jaadugar / 天幕のジャードゥーガル) episode 10 sits in late-cour pressure, when habits are no longer enough. This is not a plot dump. The public catalog pitch is only a floor: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education.

Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited. (Source: Crunchyroll) What the week actually asks is whether Science SARU used that floor as architecture or as wallpaper. Genres on the tin read Adventure, Drama; the useful question is which of those labels got camera time and which were merchandising.
